description: This file contains unit tests for the NotificationForwardingPolicy class and related functionalities such as parsing time strings, quiet hours logic, package filtering, and rate limiting.

classes.name: NotificationForwardingPolicyTest
classes.description: A test suite for NotificationForwardingPolicy class testing parsing, package filtering, quiet hours, and rate limiting functionalities.

methods.name: parseLocalHourMinute_parsesValidValues
methods.description: Tests valid time strings are correctly parsed into minutes.

methods.name: normalizeLocalHourMinute_acceptsStrict24HourDrafts
methods.description: Tests the normalization function accepts well-formed 24-hour time strings.

methods.name: parseLocalHourMinute_rejectsInvalidValues
methods.description: Tests invalid time strings are rejected.

methods.name: normalizeLocalHourMinute_rejectsNonCanonicalDrafts
methods.description: Tests that malformed or non-canonical time strings are rejected.

methods.name: allowsPackage_blocklistBlocksConfiguredPackages
methods.description: Verifies blocklist mode correctly blocks configured packages.

methods.name: allowsPackage_allowlistOnlyAllowsConfiguredPackages
methods.description: Verifies allowlist mode only allows configured packages.

methods.name: isWithinQuietHours_handlesWindowCrossingMidnight
methods.description: Checks correct behavior when quiet hours window crosses midnight.

methods.name: isWithinQuietHours_sameStartEndMeansAlwaysQuiet
methods.description: Tests behavior when quiet start and end times are identical.

methods.name: blocksEventsWhenDisabledOrQuietHoursOrRateLimited
methods.description: Verifies events are blocked when disabled, during quiet hours, or rate-limited.

methods.name: burstLimiter_blocksEventsAboveLimitInSameMinute
methods.description: Tests rate limiter blocks events exceeding max within the same minute.

methods.name: burstLimiter_resetsOnNextMinuteWindow
methods.description: Verifies rate limiter resets on window change.
